rationales.authenticity: Specific labor signs (pains half an hour apart, when to send for her if waters break) are medically and period-appropriate.
rationales.character: 'Ah, well now, 'tis good ye're thinkin' ahead' and practical midwife advice ring true and warm.
rationales.craft: Strong delivery of practical advice, but truncated at the end and slightly verbose for the 2-4 sentence brief.
rationales.language: Hiberno-English register is natural; mostly well-formed, though truncated.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly answers when to fetch the midwife with concrete, actionable guidance.
